title: Structured logging (structlog) for the refunds service
body:
Introduces `app.utils.logging` (structlog + `redact()` for PII) and converts the refunds service as the pilot. Datadog can now facet on `charge_id` / `amount_cents` instead of us regex-parsing messages.

Convention proposal: snake_case event name as the message, everything else as keyword fields.
author: carol

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+"""structlog setup. Use snake_case event names and keyword fields; no f-string messages."""
+
+import re
+
+import structlog
+
+_EMAIL = re.compile(r"[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+")
+_PAN = re.compile(r"\b(\d{6})\d{3,9}(\d{4})\b")
+
+
+def get_logger(name: str) -> structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger:
+    return structlog.get_logger(name)
+
+
+def redact(value: str) -> str:
+    """Mask emails and card numbers before logging."""
+    value = _EMAIL.sub("***@***", value)
+    return _PAN.sub(r"\1******\2", value)
